steps.description: v7.1: the HUD (Aura/Dollar top bar + weather bar) must be visible immediately — the client builds its UI before any server wait, so a missing HUD means the wrong file, not a broken game.
Roll the Common Dice: the physical die tumbles, the brainrot lands in the base (2x bigger) and in the Roblox Backpack as a Tool (hotbar 1, 2, 3).
Index: 6 tabs, one per weather event; rolls are stamped into the tab of the weather they were rolled in. A random 60-second buff event (never Basic as an event) multiplies values.
Rebirth panel + Luck shop: rebirth unlocks the next Dice tier, +50% income and one more base slot (4 open at Rebirth 0, all 10 at Rebirth 6).
